note: NSP One-Hot uses no language model at all: it is the floor. If BOFFIN's head does not beat it, the ESM-2 embeddings are contributing nothing and the whole architecture is unjustified. NetSurfP-2.0 and 3.0 are the published state of the art, built on a 650M-parameter backbone against BOFFIN's 35M, so they are a ceiling to approach rather than a target to match.
